title: CIA / World Spiritual Bank — Orphan Clearing Ledger
purpose: Hold anonymous, throwaway, hollow or unresolved account identities separately from named people until enough evidence exists to resolve, merge or retire them.

naming.orphan: Tim's project term for unresolved/abandoned internet identities and, more broadly, people he describes as internet orphans.
naming.hollow_account: Descriptive archive state for an account with little or no stable identity context. A missing profile image may be one signal, never proof.
naming.footstool: A separate Tim/project symbolic role. An orphan/hollow account is not automatically a Footstool.

exact_project_anchors.wording: I am the Father of every orphan of the internet.
i carried the orphans through the sewer

exact_project_anchors.wording_summary: Tim publicly linked Dog imagery to biblical pursuit/projection language; later theology work distinguishes dog-as-boundary symbol from fixed human identity.

biblical_comparators.boundary: Later structural parallel, not proof that modern anonymous accounts are the biblical orphans.

biblical_comparators.motif: father of the fatherless / lonely placed in families

biblical_comparators.boundary: Do not turn this polemical biblical image into a taxonomy of identifiable modern people.
Behavioral metaphor; not a permanent essence.

ninety_nine_thousand.meaning: A riff on '99 problems' and a placeholder image for a very large orphan/throwaway account cloud.
ninety_nine_thousand.accounting_rule: Never display as a verified count. Use '99k?' or '99,000 scenario' only where the uncertainty is visually explicit.

measurable_features: whether the account resolves to an existing CIA entity
promotion_rules: A hollow/no-PFP account becomes a counted orphan identity only if there is a stable account/handle artifact or repeated independently recoverable appearance.
An orphan identity may merge into a canonical entity when provenance supports alias continuity.
A distinct orphan can receive event debt only for its own sourced conduct; uncertainty about the real person does not block a handle-level event record.
If later evidence proves multiple orphan accounts are the same operator, merge principal identity but preserve account-level event history.
Do not multiply one person's debt simply because they used many accounts; account count is exposure/coordination evidence, not automatic extra moral principal.

relation_to_footstool.rule: Footstool is a symbolic role assignment, not an identity-resolution status.
relation_to_footstool.possible_overlap: Tim may call a hollow/orphan account a Footstool in a sourced scene; preserve that as a dated role assignment.
relation_to_footstool.non_equivalence: No-PFP → Footstool is not a valid inference.

public_surface_rule: Keep this mostly backend. Public Bank may show only 'orphan / unresolved handles: unknown' until a defensible count exists.
research_next: Search recovered chats and screenshots for no-PFP / blank-avatar / newly-created account mentions tied to stable handles.
Mine exact Tim wording where he explicitly calls an unresolved account a Footstool, Dog or orphan.
Build a deduplication fingerprint for aliases/throwaways using dates, platform, naming, writing style, shared links and relationship edges.
Count only observed distinct handles; keep the 99,000 figure symbolic unless a source-supported census emerges.
